ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed shareholders, directors, representatives, signatories, and UBOs against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, Colombian domestic FIU/UIAF lists, and Colombian public-sector PEP databases. The screening must be completed before notarization and before submission of the company registry filing; a negative-match certification must be executed by the compliance officer and retained for at least five years under Decreto 830 de 2021 and UIAF SARLAFT requirements.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) and Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá virtual services – 'Certificado de Homonimia / Reserva de Nombre'
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be composed in Spanish or in a Spanish-compatible transliteration; the legal corporate designation 'S.A.S.' or the expression 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' must appear in the full denominación. Latin-script names are accepted if they are clearly pronounceable and not confusingly similar to a registered name; non-Spanish names must be transliterated into Spanish for the Certificado de Homonimia and the Registro Único Empresarial y Social. The commercial name (nombre comercial) may be in English only after the registered Spanish denominación is established and inscribed in the non-commercial registry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Identical or confusingly similar existing registered names in the same activity class
Words implying official state endorsement without prior ministerial authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the name reservation is rejected, the person shall file a written 'recurso de reposición' with the issuing Cámara de Comercio within ten business days after notification. The Cámara may modify or confirm the rejection; upon confirmation, the applicant may file a 'recurso de apelación' before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within five business days after notification of the reposición decision. A newly proposed name, or the same name after judicial or administrative authorization, is re-filed as a new reservation with a fresh 30-day window. No statutory right of name extension exists beyond the 30-day reservation period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Conditionally permitted. Colombian law requires a physical domicile and a street address in the jurisdiction of a Cámara de Comercio where legal notices may be served. A licensed virtual-office provider that supplies a local physical address, mail handling, and acceptance of service may satisfy this requirement for a low-risk software-only S.A.S. Nevertheless, because the entity performs Electronic Medical Record (EMR) workflow software services, the registered office must also support the data-protection obligations under Ley 1581 de 2012; a physical operational address or an appointed data protection officer with local presence will be expected for substantive HealthTech licensing and for clinical customer audits.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. Quantified annual risk of unannounced on-site inspection by the Cámara de Comercio or DIAN is estimated at 5% to 8% in the first year for a low-risk standard IT/software exporter; inspections become materially more likely (approximately 20%) if clinical data processing authorization, tax benefit claims, or flagged PEP/sanction events arise.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (S.A.S. provisions), Código de Comercio de Colombia Títulos I-II (registration and mercantile obligations), Ley 1581 de 2012 (data protection) where applicable.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la circunscripción (Registro Mercantil) and its virtual portal RUES
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (or Escritura Pública No. __ if in-kind real estate contributed)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital for S.A.S. The subscribed capital may be paid in installments, and the term for full payment cannot exceed two years. No escrow account is required by law, except that in-kind contributions must be supported by an independent valuation and sworn statement.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: That the subscribers' subscription of shares in this Company, as set forth in the incorporated agreement, is ratified and the required initial capital installments are duly acknowledged. FURTHER RESOLVED: That the registered office of the Company shall be established at the following address: [Registered Office], within the jurisdiction of the Chamber of Commerce of Bogotá. FURTHER RESOLVED: That the following individuals are hereby appointed as Directors: [Name 1] as President, [Name 2] as Secretary, and [Name 3] as Treasurer, to serve during the first fiscal year. FURTHER RESOLVED: That the officers are authorized to execute all necessary filings, open bank accounts, and undertake operational formalities in conformity with Colombian law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de [City] – Virtual RUES portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online application through the Registro Único Empresarial (RUES) requesting the exclusive use of the desired corporate name. Provide the proposed name and company type. The system performs a homonyms search and reserves the name for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Request letter with valid corporate name
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If negative, propose an alternative name and re-apply within 24 hours.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and notarization of the incorporation contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice Notarial Office (optional only if in-kind real estate capital is contributed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the private incorporation document (documento privado) and bylaws of the S.A.S. in Spanish. Each shareholder must sign directly; if real estate is contributed, the document must be elevated to public deed before a Notary.
required_dossiers: Sworn statement of capital payment (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any missing signatures or clauses and re-execute.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the Chamber of Commerce (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de [City] – Registro Mercantil Branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the signed incorporation contract and required annexes to the Chamber of Commerce along with the official registration fee. Upon approval, the Chamber assigns the National Identification Number NIT and issues the Commercial Registration Certificate.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to cures within 10 business days; re-file denatured documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration with DIAN (Registro Único Tributario)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – cita virtual
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the NIT, schedule an online appointment to finalize the RUT. Disclose the exact business activity (ISIC 6201), registration in the national health and safety software registry, and apply for electronic invoicing certification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify RUT inconsistencies through the DIAN's virtual module.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio / Municipal Administrative Department (for permitting)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the officers' appointments in the Chamber's books (i.e., the board resolution in the corporate minutes). Open a corporate bank account, register the company with a social security operator and an occupational risk administrator, and obtain the municipal business operating license (Registro de Industria y Comercio) if required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Use the 'Registro de Suspensión de Efectos' to correct registry errors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social – Dirección de Tecnología e Informática
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registro de Historia Clínica Electrónica Interoperable (HCEI) and Authorization to Process Personal Health Data (low-risk supervisory order)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Administrative office activities do not trigger a full EIA. A mandatory environmental impact statement is not required; however, the company must file a waste management plan for e-waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater discharge or VOC emissions. Compliance with Resolution 1512/2010 for e-waste recycling; and Law 1252/2008 for battery disposal. For data centres: thermal and noise limits under municipal ordinance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire prevention inspection certificate (sobre Consulta Técnica de Bomberos) confirming infrastructure meets fire-code; structural certificate for the office; health and safety registration with ARL and Annual Occupancy Permit from the local Planning Department.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); taxpayer portal: MUISCA (https://muisca.dian.gov.co)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Colombian S.A.S. is required to register with the Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) upon incorporation. As part of that registration, DIAN automatically assigns the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria). The company must then complete its RUT (Registro Único Tributario) profile, obtain an electronic signature suitable for DIAN procedures, and appoint a legal representative with authority to manage tax filings. For a foreign-owned S.A.S., the incorporating resolution, private deed, or notarized instrument must identify all foreign shareholders and their respective identification documentation. The legal representative must be a resident individual authorized to interact with DIAN and may be granted power of attorney through notarial or apostilled documents. VAT registration and e-invoicing activation occur through the same RUT system. Foreign persons acting directly as service providers or suppliers must also obtain a NIT via the DIAN simplified enrollment process, but the local S.A.S. is the standard entity for software export operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No entity classification election is available. Colombian legislation does not provide a check-the-box regime or any analogous US-style classification election. A Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada (S.A.S.) is mandatorily treated as a corporation and tax resident of Colombia for income tax purposes. No fiscally transparent alternative is available at the S.A.S. level. Colombia applies domestic anti-hybrid mismatch rules for cross-border arrangements, and affected taxpayers must assess and disclose any hybrid mismatch resulting in a double deduction or deduction-without-inclusion outcome.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary threshold applies to corporate entities; every S.A.S. engaged in taxable activities must register in the RUT as an IVA responsible party before commencing operations. For natural persons, a simplified-regime threshold may apply, but it is not available to the corporate entity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing. The S.A.S. must issue all sales invoices through a DIAN-authorized Operador Tecnológico or directly through the MUISCA system. Each invoice must contain either a CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) or CUDS (Código Único de Documento Soporte) and be transmitted to DIAN in XML format for validation before or at the time of issuance. The e-invoicing system requires electronic delivery to the recipient, storage in DIAN archival environments, and compliance with the technical API or web-service requirements established by DIAN. Digital stamping and validation status are managed exclusively by DIAN in real time.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of services qualifies for the 0% VAT rate when the service is used or exploited exclusively outside Colombia, the recipient is domiciled abroad and is not a Colombian entity or individual, and the supplier is a Colombian resident. For the EMR SaaS service to a foreign medical clinic, the supplier must evidence through the commercial agreement, technical configuration, and usage logs that (i) the clinical users and data processing are located outside Colombia, (ii) the software is installed or accessed for a foreign operator, and (iii) no Colombian-sourced benefit or taxable consumption occurs. Exports of goods are zero-rated upon physical departure from Colombia under the appropriate customs export procedure.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DIAN-validated electronic export invoice (factura electrónica de venta) bearing the applicable CUFE/CUDS stamp and referencing the export service contract.

Foreign-destination evidence package comprising the executed SaaS agreement with the non-Colombian medical clinic, technical service-certificate, remote access or cloud-delivery logs demonstrating exclusive offshore consumption, and, for physical goods, the Declaración de Exportación and Bill of Lading or Airway Bill.

Foreign-currency payment evidence including the inward remittance certificate issued by a Colombian authorized foreign exchange intermediary or the Certificado de Liquidación de Divisas proving repatriation of export proceeds.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may audit the export zero-rating claim at any time within the general statute of limitations. If the zero-rating is disallowed, DIAN will retroactively assess VAT at the 19% rate on the gross export invoice, together with default interest and the penalty for omission or inaccuracy, which commonly equals 100% of the amount omitted and can be increased to 200% when the misstatement was willful or involved fabricated documentation. Fraudulent export declarations, sham offshore contracts, or false inward-remittance certificates may also give rise to criminal liability for tax fraud, money-laundering, or customs offenses, as well as suspension from the e-invoicing and exporter regime.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) in coordination with the Foreign Exchange Commission (Comisión de Cambios). Foreign-exchange regulation and enforcement are principally governed by Decree 1735 of 1993, the External Regulations (DCIN 83, Circular Financiera), and the supervisory oversight of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a free floating exchange-rate regime with full convertibility for current-account transactions, including trade in goods and services, dividend and profit remittances, and interest payments, subject to mandatory channeling through the authorised foreign-exchange market. Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, equity subscriptions, and financial swaps, are assessable and must be formally registered with Banco de la República. Profit remittance by a foreign-owned S.A.S. is lawful once annual financial statements are approved and corporate income tax, withholding tax on dividends, and any applicable remittance taxes are settled. No exchange-denial or administrative restriction applies to genuine operating inflows/outflows, but a hard-currency shortage or a 60% limit on foreign participation would trigger heightened regulatory review. For a fully-owned non-resident S.A.S., the practical limit is a greater documentary burden, not convertibility failure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Colombian foreign-exchange rules, proceeds from exported goods must be repatriated and channeled through an authorised intermediary within six (6) months from the date of the shipping document or customs declaration. For exported services, the same six (6) month term is counted from the date of invoice or completion of the service. The proceeds must be surrendered in the formal FX market at the bank's prevailing reference rate; the mandatory conversion ratio for export receipts intended for local use is 100%. Holding export proceeds abroad requires prior authorisation of Banco de la República. Failure to surrender within the statutory term may result in administrative fines and potential criminal exposure under Colombian foreign-exchange regulations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low viability for offshore digital EMI (Electronic Money Institution) accounts. Colombian law does not grant foreign EMI licences the status of a regulated banking or foreign-exchange intermediary; holding operational treasury funds and receiving export proceeds in Colombia requires settlement through a licensed commercial bank or a locally licensed SEDPE (Sociedad Especializada en Depósitos y Pagos Electrónicos). A local digital wallet with a licensed custodial bank may be used only as a complementary collection rail, not as the primary treasury or forex clearing channel. All high-value SaaS billing, export receipts, and profit remittance flows must pass through a formal banking account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a Colombian S.A.S. with non-resident shareholders/directors, the general rule requires the legal representative or an appointed attorney-in-fact to appear physically before a bank compliance officer or notary public in Colombia to execute the account-opening mandate and complete the KYC interview. Remote account opening is allowed for certain banks through permitted digital-onboarding procedures, provided the presenting documents are apostilled, certified, and accompanied by an verifiable video call; however, capital-escrow accounts and foreign-inflow purposes usually require the physical presence or a local power-of-attorney holder with certified identification for the initial wiring and FX declaration workflow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity in an offshore holding structure or registered in a jurisdiction with elevated tax-secrecy indicators
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled constitutional documents of the S.A.S. and its direct/indirect parent entities; full organisational chart; certified copies of passports or ID cards of all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs) holding more than 10%; proof of beneficial-ownership registration with the Colombian risks-and-AML authority; and an external legal opinion confirming economic substance and legitimate sourcing of capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent transaction profile: high-velocity cross-border SaaS payments to/from medical professionals and clinics without a corresponding IT-services documentary trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sample EMR software subscription agreements, clinic service agreements, detailed subscriber lists, invoicing and collections records, merchant-of-record justification, and a 12-month bank statement demonstrating predictable monthly recurring revenue matching the company's license-and-support fee schedule; data-flow map showing MAC addresses or unique user counts to evidence genuine end-client usage.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Health-data-sensitivity red flags: processing of protected health information (PHI) requires sectoral licensing and raises information-security risks
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Ministry of Health and Social Protection registration for licensed medical-information software, ISO 27001 and HIPAA certification evidence, GDPR/Law 1581 of 2012 data-processing registrations, executed data-processing agreements with customer clinics, and a third-party security audit report confirming data-residency and access-control mechanisms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Thin financial structure in Colombia: minimal paid-in capital, no local physical office or contracted workforce
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Proof of subscribed and paid-in capital via bank wire from the parent entity, specific Capex/Opex budget projections for the first two fiscal years, independent office-administration or virtual-office services contract with a Colombian provider, employment or professional-services agreement for at least one local representative, and corporate tax registration (Registro Único Tributario).

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All non-resident shareholder equity contributions must be wired from the investor's bank to the Colombian S.A.S. capital-escrow account using SWIFT MT103 for same-day value, referencing the company's NIT and the 'Registro de Inversión Internacional' (foreign-investment registration) procedure. The wire must be presented to the Colombian bank's foreign-exchange desk together with the formal investment declaration (Form 1 under Banco de la República's exchange forms) and a statutory audit confirmation. FX conversion to COP occurs at the market rate; the bank obtains a 'cambio' supporting statement and registers the capital flow with Banco de la República. A notarized capital subscription agreement and proof of inbound wire from the beneficial owner's account are required to secure profit-repatriation rights.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SaaS license fees, cloud-service payments, and subcontractor expenses must be settled through a regulated bank-managed FX channel. A SWIFT MT103 wire instructing the Colombian bank to convert COP and transfer USD/EUR is made, accompanied by a service-import declaration (Form 12 or equivalent) and the underlying contract or commercial invoice. For physical or embedded-hardware components, a commercial letter of credit (SWIFT MT700) may be used when a transport document and customs entry are required. Payments to foreign cloud providers must use the applicable service-import purpose code (e.g., software, IT services, or licensing) and must remain compliant with Banco de la República's reporting thresholds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forward foreign-exchange contracts (forwards a medida) for COP/USD and COP/EUR, covering known or anticipated commercial exposures
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) on COP/USD, permissible only for the purpose of hedging real commercial or financial exposures and under a licensed intermediary with central-bank registration
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps and basis swaps between COP and USD/EUR, executed through authorized entities and reported under Banco de la República's derivative-reporting framework
Foreign-exchange options (call/put) on COP/USD, permitted for hedging commercial positions and not for speculative open positions
FX futures contracts traded on a regulated Colombian or international futures exchange, with margining through an authorized intermediary
